name: Needle in a Haystack
description: A seeded ~45,000-word chronicle of an invented city (≈60k tokens) with ten planted needles spread from 0% to 100% depth: six single facts, two 2-hop chains whose halves sit far apart, a total that must be summed from three scattered mentions, and a value that the text later corrects. Every needle is shadowed by a near-miss distractor (Daskwell vs Taskwell, 317 vs 371 arches). One call, ten short answers, graded deterministically. Separates models that truly track long context from those that skim, pattern-match the nearest name, or stop reading halfway.
hook: 45,000 words. Ten needles. One near-miss decoy for each. Who reads to the end?
author: Gauntlet Core
